scope: Recovered native control flow. This catalog documents behavior; it does not claim browser implementation.

Say.behavior: Starts _AI_Say for regular info; comment info starts Entity::StartSay. Native voice, stage direction, camera and completion callbacks are asynchronous.

Description.behavior: Case insensitive description marker skipped while advancing script lines; text supplies menu/title metadata.

Give.behavior: Assures requested item template in donor inventory, then delegates transfer to PSInfoManager::Give; direct subtraction without native assurance differs.

GiveXP.behavior: Info command passes self=None and other=player. The XP callback has participant/party gates; world/None self multiplies the request by 5. Level threshold is trunc(0.5*500*(Level+1)*(Level+2)); each call increments Level at most once, adding 10 LP plus 1 when Perk_Learn is active. Reviewed assembly governs the arithmetic and callback order.

CloseQuest.behavior: Open0 -> Obsolete4; otherwise attempts Cancelled5, which only accepts Running1.

SucceedQuest.behavior: Open0 or Running1 -> Success2 through SetStatus reward path.

SuccessQuest.behavior: Source typo is absent from native command table; unknown-command warning path. Do not silently repair original command.

End.behavior: PSInfoManager::End; also reached by Sleep fallthrough.

EndGame.behavior: Plays G3_Credits.bik and G3_Credits2.bik, then terminates application.

rewards: Enclave amount >0 increments fame on matching enclave.
Nonempty attribute ID increments base value by attribute amount.
Nonzero ExperiencePoints calls GiveXP with self=world,other=player; final XP is context-derived.
Job reward fields remain source data; this SetStatus body does not implement them.
otherEffects: Arena types5/12 update ArenaStatus depending on Running.
Ardea_Revolution success disables tutorial8 and opens TUT_AfterFight when enabled.

infoAvailability.rule: Given infos rejected except conditionType51 End, then AreConditionsFulfilled.

infoGiven.rule: Successful native InfoScript start marks Given except InfoType0/4, conditionType9/51/52, Permanent true, or player owner; this marking precedes asynchronous command completion.
infoGiven.unknown: 108 original INIs omit Permanent; normalized null preserves original field absence. Fresh LoadInfosFromInis factory initialization sets effective Permanent=false. Restored runtime state must still be read separately.

infoCommonConditions.ownerNearEntity: Native GetDistOwnerToEntity multiplies world distance by 0.25 for a target with NPC property set, otherwise by 1; missing entities return 99999. The adjusted value must be <=500 (2000 world centimetres to NPC targets, 500 to other targets).
infoCommonConditions.playerKnows: All event IDs must be found in player-memory event array.
infoCommonConditions.items: When CondItemContainer resolves, each required stack must exist and meet amount.

infoDelivery.trigger: OnCommandCompleted advances to native command index1 after skipping description.
infoDelivery.rule: Only condition8/9. Questtype0 transfers remaining amounts from player to info owner. Condition8 type1/4 increments matching owner target counter and checks delivery; type3/6 Success2+StopBringNPC; type7 Success2+StopGuidePlayer.

infoOnEnd.rule: Condition6/21 starts/restarts quest Running1;11 cancels; party/teach/mob conditions invoke further native callbacks. Say records append to quest log for condition3/4/5/6/7/8/10/11/19.
